name: Dull Skin
description: Dull skin refers to a lack of radiance and an overall tired appearance of the skin. This condition is often characterized by a loss of光泽和活力。
causes: Environmental factors such as pollution and UV rays
symptoms: Skin feels rough to the touch
recommended_ingredients: Exfoliating acids such as glycolic or lactic acid
Retinol for cell turnover and anti-aging benefits
ingredients_to_avoid: Harsh exfoliants that may damage the skin barrier
Overuse of retinoids without proper consultation
Irritating ingredients like alcohol or fragrances
recommended_product_categories: Sunscreen to protect the skin from UV damage

daily_routine.purpose: Remove impurities and prepare the skin for other treatments.
Gently remove dead skin cells to reveal smoother, brighter skin.
Lock in moisture and provide essential hydration throughout the day.

professional_treatments: LED light therapy for skin rejuvenation
natural_remedies: Application of aloe vera gel to soothe and hydrate the skin
Use of honey as a natural moisturizer and antibacterial agent
Incorporating green tea into skincare routines due to its antioxidant properties
lifestyle_tips: Stay hydrated by drinking plenty of water
Maintain a balanced diet rich in fruits and vegetables
Use sunscreen daily to protect against UV damage
common_myths: Dull skin is solely caused by aging.
Exfoliating daily will always improve the appearance of dull skin.
when_to_consult_doctor: If home remedies do not show improvement, if there are signs of infection such as redness or pus, or if you experience severe irritation after using any product.
prevention: Protect the skin from environmental damage with sunscreen
Use appropriate products for your skin type

severity_levels.mild: Minor lack of radiance, visible when skin is closely examined but does not affect overall appearance.
severity_levels.moderate: Visible signs of dullness, noticeable to others and may impact confidence in daily life.
severity_levels.severe: Significant loss of glow and brightness, affecting the overall appearance and causing discomfort.

expert_tips: Always patch test new products before full application
Consult with a dermatologist for personalized skincare advice
Be consistent with your skincare routine for best results
